sources.title: SlayerLab/Slayer1B-1.01-checkpoints · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Slayer1B 1.01 — training checkpoints Full trainer checkpoints of the run that produced Slayer1B 1.01: continued training of Slayer1B 1.00 from its last checkpoint before the learning-rate decay (ckpt_1050.pt), with a new total budget of twice the tokens per parameter of 1.00. Each file holds the model weights and the optimizer state.
